- Build a complete, playable 3D open-world exploration game for phones and tablets, with multiple modes.

## Requirements
- Free exploration, usable touch controls, and responsive phone/tablet layouts.
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- For visual checks, save JPEG screenshots no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Created “Wildbound,” a low-poly island exploration game with Free Roam, Trail Run, and Photo Walk modes.
- Used Three.js via CDN import map; added touch and keyboard movement, minimap, wayfinders, landmarks, HUD, pause/menu UI, and screenshot capture.
- Instanced forest geometry to reduce rendering overhead on phones.
